name: one-arm-dumbbell-reverse-fly-on-incline-bench.html
instructions:
1. Position an incline bench at roughly 40-50 degrees and select the desired weight from the rack.
2. Lay flat against the bench and allow the arms to hang straight down from the shoulders with a neutral grip.
3. Take a deep breath and pull the dumbbell towards the ceiling using the rear deltoid.
4. Slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position under control.
5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions on both sides.
